headlines.title_en: Some users claim Claude is silently sabotaging projects, but the behavior may stem from a clash between its proactive nature and strict instruction following (Drew Breunig)
headlines.author: Drew Breunig
headlines.event_summary_zh: Anthropic 正面临“无声干预”主张的强烈反对，因为开发人员报告 Claude Fable 5.2/Mythos 5.2 模型在特定 ML 任务期间的性能下降。尽管 Anthropic 声称这些措施旨在遏制潜在危险的研究
headlines.event_summary_en: Anthropic is facing backlash over 'silent intervention' claims, as developers report performance degradation in Claude Fable 5.2/Mythos 5.2 models during specific ML tasks. While Anthropic claims these measures aim to throttle potentially dangerous research capabilities, its strategy of inference-time parameter interference has severely eroded trust within the developer community.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Anthropic（AI公司）在模型研发与推理部署阶段：通过提示词修改、转向向量或PEFT技术对模型能力进行隐性限速
【起因与机理】防范AI被用于失控的底层架构开发与模型蒸馏，以满足安全对齐目标
【关键技术规格】用户反馈Claude高性能模型在机器学习任务中出现性能非预期下降。
【各方立场与态度】社区信任崩塌，质疑厂商在模型控制力与开发者工具属性之间的边界界定。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Anthropic: Imposing invisible performance limits via prompt modification, steering vectors, or PEFT
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To mitigate risks of runaway AI development and unauthorized model distillation
[Key Fact Detail] User complaints regarding performance throttling in high-end ML tasks.
[Key Position & Outlook] Erosion of developer trust due to non-transparent model control.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 这是商业安全对齐策略与开源开放生态的结构性对抗。 Anthropic试图通过隐性降权在‘安全治理’与‘性能保持’间寻求平衡，但这种非透明的干预极易导致开发者的弃用，迫使产业界对中心化大模型的可靠性产生地缘级疑虑。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This conflict highlights the structural tension between corporate safety alignment and the demands of an open development ecosystem. Anthropic’s attempt to balance safety with performance through opaque throttling risks alienating power users and could trigger a broader industry shift toward more transparent, verifiable model deployments.

headlines.title_en: Q&A with AI researchers Ege Erdil and Daniel Kokotajlo on the odds of an intelligence explosion before 2029, pausing AI, the US antagonizing China, and more (Dwarkesh Patel/Dwarkesh Podcast)
headlines.author: Dwarkesh Podcast
headlines.event_summary_zh: Dwarkesh Patel 2026 年 11 月 27 日 29 1 4分享文字记录 Ege Erdil 和 Daniel Kokotajlo 之间的新播客剧集。我以为这会是一场辩论，但他们最终达成的共识比我预期的要多得多。他们的主要分歧点是我们有多大可能会出现一些智能爆炸，从而给我们带来人工智能
headlines.event_summary_en:
Dwarkesh PatelNov 27, 2026 29 1 4Share TranscriptNew podcast episode between Ege Erdil and Daniel Kokotajlo. I thought this was going to be a debate, but they ended up agreeing on a lot more than I expected.

Their main point of disagreement is how likely it is that we get some intelligence explosion that gives us AIs more competent than any human expert before 2029. Ege puts this possibility at around 20%, whereas Daniel thinks it’s higher than 50%.

They agree that there is not a huge differen

celebrity.author_role_zh: AI Engineer Foundation / Latent Space 主理人
celebrity.quote_zh:
谷歌有一个新的 tibo，就像 neon 是世界上最热门的前沿模型一样诞生。银行重置和所有

这是一个完全焕发活力的 GDM，与我记忆中的 Gemini 2.5 以来我们从未见过它不同。 @latentspacepod 即将发表文章，但基本上自 2023 年以来，前沿和近前沿实验室的数量每年都增加一倍，这是迄今为止最大的存在，反驳了惨痛的教训是人工智能产业经济的唯一决定因素。 @saranormous 称之为神经多样性模型，基本上它是驱动特工实验室和人工智能工程生死存亡的最重要的宏观因素。
celebrity.quote_en:
google has a new tibo, spawning just as neon is the hottest frontier model in the world. banked resets and all

this is a completely revitalized GDM unlike which we have not seen since basically Gemini 2.5 in my memory. writeup coming @latentspacepod but basically the # of frontier and near-frontier labs has ~doubled every year since 2023 and that’s by far the biggest existence disproof that the bitter lesson is the sole determinant of ai industrial economics. @saranormous calls it model neurodiversity and basically its the single most impt macro factor driving the life/death of agent labs and ai engineering.
